description: This file defines the AttributeClassDiscovery class, a plugin discovery mechanism in Drupal that finds plugins using attributes, with methods for constructing the class, preparing attribute definitions, extracting providers from namespaces, and managing plugin namespaces and dependencies.

classes.name: AttributeClassDiscovery
classes.description: A class that discovers plugins using attributes, extending ComponentAttributeClassDiscovery, with methods for managing plugin namespaces, dependencies, and provider extraction based on namespaces.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes namespace and directory suffixes based on the provided subdirectory and root namespaces iterator.

methods.name: prepareAttributeDefinition
methods.description: Prepares the attribute definition, setting the provider if not already set, based on the namespace.

methods.name: getProviderFromNamespace
methods.description: Extracts the provider name from a given Drupal namespace using regex.

methods.name: getPluginNamespaces
methods.description: Generates plugin namespace mappings by appending suffixes to base namespaces and directories.

methods.name: getClassDependencies
methods.description: Determines class dependencies, focusing on provider namespaces, excluding core and component providers.

methods.name: hasMissingDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies, converting providers to Drupal namespace format for validation.
